title: Distinct relative Pantheon+ and calibrated SH0ES symmetrized-release working factors

scopes.title: Separate relative, calibrated and compatibility-stress targets
scopes.checked_claim: Relative producer selects exactly zHD>0.01:1590 released rows, including10 flagged calibrator rows used as cosmological distances. Calibrated producer selects zHD>0.01 OR IS_CALIBRATOR:1657 rows with77 calibrators using CEPH_DIST. Both use m_b_corr and the same released STAT+SYS covariance selected in original order. Relative mean=5log10[(1+zHD)(1+zHEL)DA(zHD)/Mpc]+25+M for every selected row; calibrated flagged rows instead use CEPH_DIST+M. A new explicit normalized dM uniform[-21,-17] mag and Cs=(C_selected+C_selected^T)/2 define a separate Gaussian working posterior. Host covariance/CEPH_DIST uncertainty is already included and is used once.
scopes.unresolved: No exact original producer GaussianLikelihood inversion/triangle or self.kind reproduction is claimed. New direct CLASS.angular_distance(zHD) and Cs arithmetic identity need consumer numerical/row-order/SPD/refinement and actual posterior-residual sensitivity checks. Relative1590 covariance qualification is distinct from calibrated1657 controls. Original nonsymmetric C remains structurally refused; empirical joint-dependence and absolute-calibration qualification remain open.

limitations: Brout SecII Eqs9/14/15,III.1,IV.2–4 andAppendixC were checked. Its author Planck+BAO+Pantheon+ combinations exclude SH0ES as incompatible; this is an interpretation caveat, not a mathematical prohibition on a separately named exploratory compatibility-stress fit.

Natural next joint baseline uses the relative target without Cepheid calibration. Calibrated SN-alone and an optional primary+DESI+SH0ES stress posterior must have distinct identities, label possible incompatibility and preserve per-factor diagnostics.

Relative1590 is not obtained by removing every calibrator flag from calibrated1657: only67 low-z flagged rows are removed;10 flagged rows remain and use cosmological redshift distances. Calibrated selection uses77 flags, while the paper describes81 calibrator light curves; this serialization difference is retained without inventing equivalence.

zHD is the released peculiar-velocity-corrected CMB-frame Hubble-diagram redshift; zHEL is heliocentric and supplies the observer redshift factor. A single CLASS luminosity_distance(zHD) without (1+zHEL)/(1+zHD) correction would change the source mean.

Fixed m_b_corr already incorporates SALT standardization, selection/bias/host corrections and conditioned reduction. No independent SALT-training, diagonal error, Riess H0, calibrated-M Gaussian or copied host-modulus uncertainty factor is added.

Cs is an explicitly named symmetrized-release approximation. Asymmetry is not proven rounding and does not bound missing symmetric systematic error. Preserve exact Cs bytes/arithmetic policy; no jitter, clipping or substitution for the original C.

Upper/lower symmetric-triangle completions and whitened perturbation bounds plus actual residual-specific quadratic/logdet changes are required. Engineering synthetic/MU_SH0ES controls do not qualify CLASS posterior tails. The project sensitivity budget is abs Delta lnL<=0.01 at declared representative posterior/tail states.

Unknown inherited producer interpolation and inverse policy limit release reproduction, not definition of the new direct-CLASS working target. No original nonsymmetric inverse is admitted as a covariance likelihood.
